seoTitle: Google News stock search API | Any company
seoDescription: Google News stock search API: query any company or ticker and get JSON headlines. Prefills Nvidia OR NVDA—no login.

faq.question: Is this a Google News stock search API?
faq.answer: Yes. It runs Google News RSS search queries and returns structured JSON (headline, link, source, tickers when detected) via the Apify dataset or API.

faq.question: What query is prefilled?
faq.answer: Nvidia OR NVDA for the US/English Google News index. Duplicate the task and edit searchQueries for any company, ticker, or topic.

faq.question: Do I need to change any input before starting?
faq.answer: No for a Nvidia demo. For another company, edit searchQueries (and optionally searchCountry / searchLanguage) then Start.

faq.question: Can I schedule only new Google News hits?
faq.answer: Yes. Duplicate the task, turn on Only new articles, and schedule Slack, Zapier, or webhook alerts.
